hook.name: BracketHook
hook.description: BracketHook is the central contract for the TheCup protocol, managing 48 country-token pools across two AMM regimes: a bonding curve phase (hook handles all swap math via custom virtual-reserve AMM and a 1% protocol fee) and a graduated phase (standard v4 AMM with 1% protocol fee plus an optional 9% elimination tax on sells of knocked-out country tokens). A per-block price-impact cap (5%) is enforced as a sandwich protection mechanism.
